official_measurement_examples.name: ACOMS launch
official_measurement_examples.fact: CAA announced ACOMS for crane and obstacle notifications on 22 July 2026.

official_measurement_examples.name: Crane universal notification threshold
official_measurement_examples.fact: CAA requires notification for cranes at or above 100m AGL regardless of location.

official_measurement_examples.name: Crane near-aerodrome trigger
official_measurement_examples.fact: CAA guidance requires notification within 6km where a crane exceeds 10m AGL or surrounding structures/trees if higher.

official_measurement_examples.name: En-route obstacle lighting
official_measurement_examples.fact: CAA guidance states en-route obstacles including cranes at 150m or more AGL must be lit under the Air Navigation Order.

official_measurement_examples.name: Safeguarding map radius
official_measurement_examples.fact: CAA FAQ says safeguarding maps generally cover about 15km, but criteria can vary by aerodrome.

official_measurement_examples.name: Wildlife safeguarding circle
official_measurement_examples.fact: CAA safeguarding guidance describes a 13km wildlife circle on safeguarding maps for wildlife-attracting development consultation.

official_measurement_examples.name: CAP 764 current version
official_measurement_examples.fact: CAA CAP 764 is current Version 7 dated 17 December 2025.

official_measurement_examples.name: Contrary-to-objection procedure
official_measurement_examples.fact: CAA FAQ states an LPA minded to approve contrary to an officially safeguarded aerodrome objection must notify the relevant authority and not grant within 28 days.
